bg.$description: Transparent backing for primary link text.

neutral-bg.$description: Transparent backing for neutral link text.

bg-image.$description: Optional image overlay for link backing.

underline-thickness-hover.$description: Underline thickness under a hover-capable pointer.

underline-offset.$description: Space between link text and its underline.

radius.$description: Corner radius used by the link focus outline.

font-family.$description: Body typeface used by link text.

icon-size.$description: External link icon edge relative to the inherited text size.

icon-gap.$description: Space between the label and the external link icon.
